info.name: Epic Boon Category Feats
info.description: The Epic Boon Category Feats from Arcana Unleashed.

element.name: Boon of Erupting Spellpower
element.prerequisite: Level 19+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Spell Overload. When you cast a spell that deals damage using a spell slot, you can cause its magical energy to surge. You can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die rolled for the spell as a 3, and creatures that took damage from the spell also have the Prone condition. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you roll Initiative or finish a Long Rest or Short Rest.

sheet.description: When you cast a spell that deals damage using a spell slot, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die rolled for the spell as a 3, and creatures that took damage from the spell also have the Prone condition. You also regain use of this feature when you roll Initiative.

element.name: Boon of Magic School Mastery
element.prerequisite: Level 19+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Mastered School. Choose one of the eight schools of magic: Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, or Transmutation. Your choice grants you the following features:

ul.li: Rote Casting. Choose a level 1 spell from the chosen school that appears on your class's spell list. You always have that spell prepared and can cast it without a spell slot or spell components.

Signature Arcanum. Choose a level 7 or lower spell from the chosen school. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.
You can also cast these prepared spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

description.p: Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different school of magic each time.

ul.li: Rote Casting. Choose a level 1 spell from the Necromancy school that appears on your class's spell list. You always have that spell prepared and can cast it without a spell slot or spell components.

Signature Arcanum. Choose a level 7 or lower spell from the Necromancy school. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.
You can also cast these prepared spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

sheet.description: You always can cast this feat's level 1 spell without a spell slot, and can cast this feat's level 7 spell without a spell slot once per Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Unshakable Focus. When you are maintaining Concentration on an effect, you lose Concentration only if you cast a spell or activate another effect that requires Concentration, if you have the Petrified or Unconscious condition, or if you die.
